nodes.description: Private owner address stored by Ownable; controls access control privileges.
Immutable IERC20 token held by the timelock contract.
Immutable beneficiary address that receives released tokens.
Immutable start timestamp of the token release period, rounded down to a day.
End timestamp of the release period; mutable because terminate() overwrites it.
Total benefit amount vesting to the beneficiary; reduced on terminate().
Running total of tokens already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Flag indicating whether the contract has been terminated by the owner.
Initializes token, beneficiary, release schedule and total benefit using block.timestamp.
Permissionless withdrawal of the currently released balance to the beneficiary; performs external token transfer.
Owner-only termination that reduces total benefit, resets release end time and transfers the surplus to the owner.
View computing the vested amount from block.timestamp and the release window.
View returning totalBenefit minus releasedBalance.
View returning the accumulated withdrawn balance.
View returning the held token address.
View returning the beneficiary address.
View returning the total benefit amount.
Modifier enforcing that the caller equals the stored owner via _msgSender().
Private helper that writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Owner-only ownership transfer guarded by onlyOwner and a zero-address check.
Owner-only function that sets owner to the zero address.
Returns msg.sender, abstracting the message sender of the transaction.
Modifier checking that _isTerminated is false before executing the body.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and access control.
Miner-influenceable timestamp driving the vesting schedule and termination time.
External ERC20 safeTransfer call executed after state update inside withdraw.
External ERC20 safeTransfer call paying the surplus to the owner inside terminate.
Low-level address.call performed by SafeERC20 that can transfer control to a malicious token.
Constructor parameter assigning the ERC20 token address to _token.
Constructor parameter assigning the beneficiary address to _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter trimmed to a day boundary and stored as _releaseStartTime.
Constructor parameter determining the length of the vesting window in days.
Constructor parameter assigning the vesting amount to _totalBenefit.
New owner address passed to transferOwnership and forwarded to _setOwner.
Local amount computed as releasedBalance minus withdrawedBalance and transferred.
Local surplus amount computed in terminate and transferred to the owner.
Local number of days elapsed since the release start time.
Local total number of days in the vesting window.
Local caching of the previous owner before the ownership write.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender, propagating the untrusted caller into access control logic.
The constructor uses _msgSender() to determine the initial owner of the timelock.
The onlyOwner modifier compares owner() against _msgSender() to authorize callers.
_setOwner is invoked with _msgSender() during construction, writing the caller into _owner.
terminate() is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting the state-changing path to the owner.
transferOwnership() is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting ownership changes.
renounceOwnership() is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting renunciation of ownership.
terminate() is additionally guarded by isNotTerminated, gating re-termination.
_isTerminated is read by the isNotTerminated modifier to gate terminate().
The constructor validates _releaseEndTime against block.timestamp, making deployment timestamp dependent.
releasedBalance depends directly on block.timestamp for vesting calculation.
terminate sets _releaseEndTime from block.timestamp, making termination behavior timestamp dependent.
_releaseStartTime is read to compute elapsed days in releasedBalance.
_releaseEndTime bounds the vesting window read in releasedBalance.
_totalBenefit is pro-rated by elapsed time inside releasedBalance.
unreleasedBalance derives its result from releasedBalance.
_totalBenefit is the minuend in the unreleasedBalance computation.
withdrawedBalance simply returns the _withdrawedBalance state variable.
withdraw reads _withdrawedBalance to determine how much is still claimable.
withdraw reads releasedBalance to compute the withdrawable amount.
withdraw sends the computed amount to the immutable _beneficiary.
beneficiary() returns the stored _beneficiary address.
token() returns the stored _token reference.
withdraw obtains the ERC20 handle from token() to perform the transfer.
withdraw executes an external safeTransfer to the beneficiary, creating a reentrancy surface.
safeTransfer routes through _callOptionalReturn, which performs a low-level call to an arbitrary token.
withdraw updates _withdrawedBalance before performing the external transfer.
terminate executes an external safeTransfer to the owner, creating a reentrancy surface.
terminate overwrites _totalBenefit with the currently released amount.
terminate rewrites _releaseEndTime to the current day boundary.
terminate sets _isTerminated to true, disabling further terminations.
_setOwner reads and overwrites the _owner state variable.
The onlyOwner check reads the stored _owner through owner().
transferOwnership invokes _setOwner to commit the new owner.
renounceOwnership invokes _setOwner with the zero address.
terminate pays the surplus to owner(), coupling termination payout to ownership.
withdraw indirectly depends on block.timestamp through releasedBalance, letting time gate the claimable amount.
terminate reads _withdrawedBalance to compute the surplus transferred to the owner.
terminate uses _totalBenefit to size the amount transferred to the owner.

normalization_plan.reason: token_ is a constructor parameter that directly initializes the core state variable _token inside the constructor.
beneficiary_ is a constructor parameter that directly initializes the core state variable _beneficiary.
releaseStartTime_ is a constructor parameter trimmed and stored into _releaseStartTime by the constructor.
daysOfTimelock_ is a constructor parameter used by the constructor to build _releaseEndTime.
totalBenefit_ is a constructor parameter that directly initializes the core state variable _totalBenefit.
newOwner is the transferOwnership parameter that is forwarded to _setOwner to update _owner.
amount is the local computed in withdraw and is the value passed into the core external safeTransfer call.
amountToWithdraw is the local computed in terminate and is the value passed into the core external safeTransfer call.
passedDays is a local computed inside releasedBalance and has no meaning outside that core function.
totalDays is a local computed inside releasedBalance and has no meaning outside that core function.
oldOwner is a local used only inside _setOwner to emit the ownership-transfer event.
